I wanted to be remembered by a stranger.\" The keeper read it three times, then set it on the windowsill beside the lamp, where the rotating beam touched it once every twelve seconds, steady as a heartbeat.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市，像一头将醒未醒的巨兽。街灯仍亮着，橘黄的光晕落在空无一人的马路上，洒水车缓缓驶过，留下湿润的痕迹。便利店灯光白得刺眼，值夜班的店员趴在柜台上打盹。远处高楼只剩零星几扇亮着的窗，那是不肯睡去的人。首班公交碾过寂静驶来，环卫工人的扫帚声在楼宇间轻轻回荡。街角的海棠花悄悄开了，天边泛起一线灰白，这座城市正安静地等着天亮。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by calling itself on a smaller version of the same problem, like opening a Russian nesting doll to find another, smaller doll inside.\n• It always needs a stopping rule — a base case, like the tiny last doll that doesn't open — otherwise it would keep going forever.\n• Each call does a little work and hands the rest to the next call, and when the answers come back, they stack up into the final answer, like rebuilding the doll tower from the inside out."}
